subject: Post-call recap: Acme SOC 2 / evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & SOC 2 discussion — follow up

Marissa — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can move procurement forward: 

Pain points / goals we discussed:
- Need an inference provider with clear audit logs and retention controls for PII-sensitive features.
- Must include a DPA and evidence we can share with our InfoSec team (SOC 2, pen test summaries).
- Predictable latency for customer-facing features; fallback strategy for capacity constraints.

Specific requests / next steps I mentioned: 
1) Example audit log export (sample of auth & request logs) so our security team can validate retention/format.
2) Redacted SOC 2 report or SOC 2 summary for review.
3) Draft DPA with our standard clauses to start legal review.
4) Any pen test / vuln scan summary you can share.

Can you confirm which of the above you can provide this week? Also looping Elena (security) on details.

Thanks — Samir
Sr. Security PM, Acme Corp

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & SOC 2 discussion — follow up

Samir / Elena — great to meet earlier. Summary and concrete next steps below (keeping this short for your security and procurement teams):

What we heard (confirming):
- Audit logs (request metadata, timestamps, user IDs, request/response hashes) and configurable retention (30/90/365 days) are a gating requirement.
- Need a redacted SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 summary + list of controls and scope.
- DPA negotiation: Acme has a few mandatory clauses (data residency, subprocessors, liability caps).
- Pen test / vulns: high-level pen test findings & remediation timeline preferred.

What Redwood will provide this week (target):
- Redacted SOC 2 summary + SOC 2 letter (PDF) — attached stub and link to full redacted doc for security review. (attachment: SOC2_cert_redacted.pdf)
- Sample audit log export (CSV) containing auth and request metadata — attached sample and schema description. (attachment: audit_log_sample.csv)
- Draft DPA (initial template) for your legal to review — see attached. (attachment: DPA_draft_acme.docx)
- Pen test summary: high-level exec summary and dates; we can arrange an NDA exchange for more detailed reports if needed.

Technical note (cc: Dev): we support log retention policies configurable per-tenant (default 90d). We also have live KV-cache masking for token redaction; will share a short tech note if helpful.

Next steps / ask from Acme:
- Elena: can you confirm whether the redacted SOC 2 summary and the sample CSV are sufficient for an initial risk review?
- Samir: if legal wants specific DPA language, please highlight line items; we can propose edits.
- If you want a joint session, we can schedule a 30 min follow-up with Dev and our security engineer to walk through the audit log schema and retention settings.

I'll upload the artifacts to the Drive link and send a one-click bundle for your legal team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & SOC 2 discussion — audit log sample and tech notes

Elena / Samir — quick technical follow-up from our call: 

1) Audit log sample (attached) contains the following fields: timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, user_id (hashed), endpoint, model_id, input_size, latency_ms, response_hash. We can include request body redaction for PII and show hashed identifiers instead of raw emails.

2) Retention & export: logs live for configurable periods (30/90/365). Exports can be delivered via S3 push or secure Drive link; we can set up a short-term access token for your team.

3) Pen test info: Redwood runs annual third-party pen tests; we can provide an executive summary and CVSS breakdowns. For full reports we require an NDA and a signed non-disclosure addendum to the DPA.

4) DPA process: We typically accept a limited set of redlines; point us to the specific clause numbers and we will respond within 3 business days.

If useful, I can host a 30-minute tech walkthrough on Thu or Fri — propose Thu 06/04 11:00 AM PT.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & SOC 2 discussion — audit log sample and tech notes

Marissa / Dev — thanks for the quick follow-ups and the artifacts. I reviewed the CSV sample and the SOC 2 summary looks reasonable for initial review. A few notes from Elena:

- Audit log fields: want user_id as a one-way hash (good). Will confirm retention window recommendation (likely 365d for our use case).
- DPA: legal will send a redline with a handful of clauses next week; we appreciate the 3 business day turnaround.
- Pen test: we can do the NDA flow for the full report; please send the NDA template and we will return signed.

We are happy to take the tech walkthrough on Thu 06/04 11:00 AM PT — that works for our team. Please send a calendar invite.

Samir
Sr. Security PM, Acme Corp
